scope: Offline NZM disk files only. Mesh JSON/ActorX and explicit material/parent/texture references collected. No runtime project assets changed.
completeness: This collection covers the supplied mesh plan and explicit material-parent/texture references within budget. Animation routes and skeleton configuration are retained; full animation conversion and UE reconstruction are not completed.
limitations: Input PlanJson is retained verbatim; gender and outfit completeness depend on its configuration evidence. Filename-only discovery is not a complete roster assertion.
Mesh inline exports remain in JSON; only explicit SkeletalMaterials references create material dependencies.
Textures are included by explicit serialized references; nearby Textures/Textures_HD folders are not automatically assigned to mesh slots.
Source selection follows the stated offline provider input tree; live game update mounting priority remains unverified.
Collected PSK weights/points and decoded PNG dimensions are validated when validation is enabled. No UE import, animation playback or visual validation is implied.
Shared source files already present in PCResources are referenced by exact source package and SHA256 instead of copied again.
